units.source_text: 他又对她讲了许多无关紧要的闲话，有时诙谐，有时庄严，然而对方始终不答一语。

en.t: He went on saying many trivial things to her, sometimes witty and sometimes solemn, yet she never answered a single word.

units.source_text: 源氏公子想：“这样的人真奇怪。

en.t: Prince Genji thought, "What a strange person she is.

units.source_text: 莫非她心中另有一种想法么？”

en.t: Could it be that she has some other thought in her heart?"

units.source_text: 就此告退，终不甘心，他便悄悄地拉开纸隔扇，钻进内室来。

en.t: He could not bear to leave like that, so he quietly slid open the paper screen and slipped into the inner room.

units.source_text: 大辅命妇大吃一惊，她想：“这公子使人掉以轻心，然后乘人不备……”

en.t: Taifu no Myobu was greatly startled and thought, "This prince makes people lower their guard, and then catches them unprepared..."

units.source_text: 她觉得对不起小姐，便佯装不见，退回自己房里去了。

en.t: Feeling that she had wronged her young lady, she pretended not to notice and withdrew to her own room.
